gloss: funny story; something one can laugh about now

definitions.explanation: A humorous story or anecdote told to make people laugh.
A past mishap or trouble that has become a joke in hindsight, especially in {今|いま}では{笑|わら}い{話|ばなし}だ.

examples.japanese: {笑|わら}い{話|ばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{聞|き}かせて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{笑|わら}い{話|ばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather often told us funny stories from the old days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧{笑|わら}い{話|ばなし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{大笑|おおわら}い→大笑い：15938_oowarai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone roared at the funny story my senior told at the party.
Now it's something we laugh about.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{笑|わら}い{話|ばなし}です。
examples.english: That failure is just a funny story now.

examples.japanese: {笑|わら}い{話|ばなし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{済|す}まない→済む：01950_sumu⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えよう→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's think of a plan before this becomes something no one can laugh off.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{笑|わら}い{話|ばなし}だ: we can laugh about it now
- {笑|わら}い{話|ばなし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{済|す}まない→済む：01950_sumu⟧: it's no laughing matter
- {笑|わら}い{話|ばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tell a funny story

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧: a joke — something said not to be taken seriously
- ⟦{失敗談|しっぱいだん}→失敗談：09950_shippaidan⟧: a story of one's own failures, often told as a {笑|わら}い{話|ばなし}
